title: monsters.json - the default monster pack (js/monster-std.js; rules S12 / S20)

early.description: which rooms count as the early game for tools/check-escape.mjs: the rooms reachable at the first N levels, or an explicit list

assets.description: folder of the windmill pictures (default assets/monster/)

hints.description: the protagonist's lines while chased (U23): run / turn / hide

spotFx.description: standard 1.9: the effect when this monster notices the player (js/spot-fx.js): a name (red-flash, white-flash, ink, heartbeat, static, glitch, shake, zoom, tunnel, desaturate, letterbox, word, veins), a set (jump, dread, tape, stare), { name, strength, ms, text }, or a list; a game effect registered with ext.registerSpotFx

look.description: windmill = the original みる風車 look (no red / black); dark-red-mist = near-black body, thin deep-red rim, with the red-black mist; any other name = a look the game registers with ext.registerLook (standard 1.7)

afterNear.description: with a nearAttack: do not patrol before the scripted encounter (default true)

nearRespawn.description: seconds after the scripted encounter before it patrols (default 6)

untilStage.description: this phase holds while the player's level is before this stage

route.description: 'auto' (a loop through the spawn room), a plan.routes id, { rooms: [...] } or null (stands still until it notices you)

nearAttack.description: the scripted safe attack (S8), once: when the player enters `room` it walks from `from` to `target`; it never touches anyone

kill.description: a monster that kills with its own attack instead of contact (params.catch 0): `reach` metres is where that attack lands; check-escape replays with it as the catch distance

params.description: overrides of the preset (js/monster-ai.js PRESETS): speed { wander seek chase }, sight, fov, near, notice, catch, lose { noLos corners cornersDelay dist cap hide }, hints, hintText
